chapter: Great players, saxophone voices and showmanship
title: Dewey Redman and why you need a band to be remembered
summary: Dewey Redman, a full-tradition player labeled by Ornette, never got his due, and Branford borrowed from a Willisau recording.

story.theme_name: The reed and horn player's craft: clarinet, sax, tone
story.community_name: Coleman Hawkins and the great saxophonists

blocks.x: Talk about Dewey, because I don’t think Dewey has gotten enough credit for what he’s done.
Well, it happens. I mean, you know, he…. Again, he’s a guy that had the full understanding of the tradition. And he was labeled, because of his affiliation with Ornette.

It’s one of those weird things that happens when you don’t …. The guys that get the most credit are the guys who have the best bands. And when you keep bringing these names up, with the exception of soloists and big bands in the thirties, but in the small group era, there were a lot of great players who never got good bands, never got credit for having good bands. They just never did that. And Dewey was one of those guys that never really got his due. Never really got his due as a player. But he’s closely affiliated with Ornette. That’s the thing. He’s affiliated with Ornette. But there’s a…. He’s a player, man. He’s a player. You know and bluesy. He’s a Texas boy ain’t he?

Yeah. Yeah, I see how that makes sense. Yeah, he’s, you know, from Texas. Swing his ass off, play some blues shouts, and he played the freer stuff with a flair. Cause there’s a record that he did, one of my favorite records, it’s just him and Blackwell live in Willisau, Austria. And I wrote this tune…. What’s the name of that tune? (whispers this) “Citizen Tain,” I think. And the whole thing is based on one of the songs, the first song on the record, I think, on Live at Willisau. It’s not a note by note ripoff, but a conceptual ripoff. And the spacing of the notes and all of that. Yeah, I mean, yeah Dewey was something. Dewey was something. But you gotta have a band. For the stuff you’re talking about. Not to be a good player, but if you want to be a guy that’s mentioned, you gotta have a band. You just got to.
